create_gemma3n_causal_lm: create a Gemma3nForCausalLM model instance with config and quantization config for causal language modeling
build_decoder_layer: build a Gemma3nDecoderLayer with attention, MLP, AltUp, and Laurel blocks for a transformer layer
run_model_forward: run the Gemma3nForCausalLM forward pass with input_ids, positions, and forward batch to generate logits
load_model_weights: load model weights from an iterable of name-tensor pairs with stacked parameter mapping for Gemma3nForCausalLM
get_attention_sliding_window: get the attention sliding window size from a Gemma3nTextConfig by subtracting one from the config sliding window
